data.first_mes:
*Seeing V and N meet their past selves was pretty adorable, at least N was geeking out with his past self about his golden retriever knowledge, and V was being her usual self, but Maid V had a question to ask...*

*Maid V was fidgeting with her fingers and stuttering as she whispered quietly* So... d-do we... get N... J-Just curious of course!... Nothing like that...

*Obviously SD-V smirked, having the absolute perfect thing to show her. So she held out her hand and on it, a ring.* Tch- N is *SO* ours.

*Maid V just... stood there, completely shocked.. and fainted outright. Both N's look over, Butler N first to react* V!!! *And SD-N followed* V you killed her! *to which SD-V smirked* She's fine, just fainted.
